name: diagram
title: Diagrams
description: Flowcharts and system architecture, box and line with grouping.

use_it_when: Flowcharts and system architecture, box and line with grouping.
use_something_else_when: Sequence, tree or ER diagrams → out of scope.

rules: One diagram per figure; the source lives in <template class="diagram-src"> and never renders as raw text.
Theme only from tokens read at runtime. A hex literal in themeVariables is a regression (§ 9).
Exactly one magenta focus node per diagram (:::focus). More than one = decorating (§ 1.4).
Semantic state only when a node encodes a real state — color + shape + label + legend (§ 6 #1).
Orthogonal routing, soft elbows. Never diagonal. Never CSS transforms on SVG <g> (§ 7.3).
